ExecutionDebug.Title: Runtime debugger
ExecutionDebug.Help: Set breakpoints before starting a local session. Paste the invitation into the Unity or Unreal component using the same compiled effect. Stops apply only to the selected effect's CPU execution; GPU instructions cannot be stepped.
ExecutionDebug.Compiling: Compiling the active graph for a bytecode identity check…
ExecutionDebug.Waiting: Waiting for one local runtime (two minutes).
ExecutionDebug.Windows: The local debugger currently requires Windows.
ExecutionDebug.Paused: Paused before executing the highlighted node.
ExecutionDebug.Aborted: Runtime pause timed out. Restart playback before continuing.
ExecutionDebug.CannotStart: Could not compile the graph or open a local debugger session.
ExecutionDebug.Mismatch: Runtime bytes do not match this graph revision. Re-export it and select the matching standalone or Spawnable package mode.
ExecutionDebug.Revision: Graph changed. Debugger disconnected; export and load the new revision before reconnecting.
ExecutionDebug.Limit: A session supports up to 128 breakpoints.
ExecutionDebug.CommandPending: Waiting for the runtime to acknowledge the command…
